name: The One and Only Flower in the World
source:
The story takes in the world of Iride, where basically anything you say and do will be used against you. Every nation in Iride follows a set of ideals that must be upheld within their grounds and if anybody doesn't fit a certain mold, whether for said nation or Iride overall, chances are they could face punishment or even death. Q.P. is a 12-year-old boy who isn't treated kindly by the other denizens due to his girlish appearance and shy mannerisms, all except his caretaker Atsushi, who entrusts him with a mysterious flower known as the Prismflower as a sign of their special bond. Unfortunately, their happy times are cut short when Atsushi gets taken away and Q.P. is all alone again. With the Prismflower as his only sign of hope, Q.P. now begins his search for Atsushi and the Prismflower petal bearers.

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/marykosmosver2/art/The-One-and-Only-Flower-in-the-World-920596646]DeviantArt[/url]]
